summary: Tested the 4 requested changes: (1) anti-Chrome-translation attributes on brand, (2) palinsesto 8-position cycle with jingle every 2 songs, (3) player fluidity DJ-voice fallback, (4) GridFS (not implemented, not tested). Backend: new pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_palinsesto_jingle.py — 5/5 passed (station endpoint, jingle library, full 8-position cycle 0=music,1=music,2=jingle,3=rubrica,4=time_signal/ad/weather,5=music,6=music,7=jingle, jingle audio reachable, talk speech_audio_url reachable in <5s). Frontend: html lang='it' + meta google=notranslate + Content-Language=it served; every [data-testid=brand-name] on / and /dashboard renders 'R-A.I.' with translate='no' and class notranslate. Player fluidity verified by intercepting **/api/tts/** with a 20s hang: console logged 'DJ voice failed/slow (>3s) — skipping to full-volume music' and the music segment (Piove RAM) kept playing at full volume with active visualizer. One REGRESSION found: /api/analytics now returns 500 because jingle segments are inserted with llm_provider=None.

critical.issue: 500 AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'split' at server.py:1876. Regression: the new jingle slot (pos 2/7) inserts Segment(...) without llm_provider, so llm_provider is None in Mongo and s.get('llm_provider','unknown').split('/') crashes (8 such docs already stored). Dashboard fires this call twice on load. Fix: (s.get('llm_provider') or 'unknown').split('/')[0] and/or set llm_provider='jingle' on the jingle segment.

minor.issue: First sync generation from the browser exceeded the frontend 30s axios timeout ('fetchSegment attempt 1/3 failed: timeout of 30000ms exceeded'), delaying first audio by ~25-30s. LLM+TTS generation is slow; consider pre-generating/queueing.

Ad-rotation branch (22% random) can return an ad before the palinsesto branch; it does not consume a playlist position so the cycle is preserved, but an ad can land between the 2 songs and the jingle. Verify this is intended.

Jingle library contains duplicate titles (3x 'Notte Analogica', 3x 'Aurora Statica', 2x 'Silicio Blu' as separate docs), so the same jingle title can repeat inside one 8-position cycle even though last_played_at rotation works.

ui_bugs.issue: Embed renders 'Video unavailable — Playback on other websites has been disabled by the video owner / Watch on YouTube' text that shows through over the hero and now-playing card on / (visible in screenshots). Should be hidden/replaced with a fallback visual.

Second brand-name instance on home page has computed font-family 'Unbounded, sans-serif' (caller passes a style override that beats the monospace lock the component was written to enforce). Text still reads R-A.I. correctly but the anti-collapse font fix is bypassed there.

integration_issues.issue: /api/analytics returns 500 on every dashboard load (2 calls), so analytics widgets cannot render real data
One transient 'Music load error: /api/suno_audio/track_b7a05e93....mp3' in the browser although the same URL returns 200 via curl — likely a range/abort race in headless; monitor.

issues: 'Video unavailable' YouTube overlay text bleeds over hero copy and player card

action_items: Fix /api/analytics 500: guard None llm_provider (server.py:1876) and set llm_provider (e.g. 'jingle') on jingle segments created at palinsesto positions 2/7
Hide/replace the unavailable YouTube background embed on the home page
Consider raising the 30s fetchSegment timeout or pre-warming the queue — first play currently waits ~25-30s
Optional: dedupe jingle tracks so the same jingle title doesn't repeat within a cycle
critical_code_review_comments: server.py analytics(): s.get('llm_provider','unknown') does not protect against explicit None values stored in Mongo — always use `or` defaults for nullable fields

radioEngine._playMusicWithVoice: after the speech element's onended sets this.currentAudio=null, the music element is no longer tracked in currentAudio, so a Stop/next playSegment stopAudio() cannot pause the still-playing music element (stopMusic covers the legacy path only). Worth auditing for overlap on manual stop.
radioEngine.js is 1279 lines — consider splitting playback strategies into separate modules
seed_data_creation: None. Station state playlist_position was reset to 0 during cycle testing; ~11 segments generated in db.segments.
test_credentials: Not needed — admin actions are open in beta; /api/auth/me returns 401 as expected when logged out
context_for_next_testing_agent: Palinsesto cycle test resets station state via mongosh (test_database). Re-run: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_palinsesto_jingle.py -p no:randomly. Player fluidity fallback is reproducible by page.route('**/api/tts/**') with a 20s delay then clicking [data-testid=play-pause-button] and skipping until a non-jingle music segment plays; look for console 'DJ voice failed/slow (>3s)'. Brand anti-translation attributes verified on / and /dashboard. GridFS was intentionally not implemented.
rca_of_the_issue: The new jingle slot builds Segment(kind='music', ... ) without llm_provider, which Pydantic stores as None. GET /api/analytics does s.get('llm_provider','unknown').split('/') — .get returns None (key exists) so .split raises AttributeError -> 500 for every dashboard load. Reproduce: curl /api/analytics after any jingle segment has been generated.
